method: Identify the named entity and decision use.
Resolve a primary or entity-controlled source.
Verify current jurisdiction, legal status, program fit, and funding/client role separately.
Record evidence date, uncertainty, conflicts, and rationale.
Classify only to the resolution supported; never infer funding availability or licensure.

boundary: This dated educational comparison is not legal, investment, licensing, clinical, or market advice.
